blocks.text: Garage Cleanout in the GTA — Done in One Visit

c: A garage full of years of clutter is not something you can clear in a weekend. Live Junk Free provides a professional garage cleanout service across the Greater Toronto Area. Our trained crew loads everything into the truck and hauls it away in a single visit. You open the garage door. We do the rest.

We take everything: old tools, broken appliances, boxes, furniture, renovation debris, tires, and scrap metal. Whether you need a full garage cleanout before selling your home, after a renovation, or simply to reclaim your space — all garage junk removal is handled in one trip. No sorting, no trips to the dump. Just a clean, empty garage.

items.title: Book in 60 Seconds
text: Call 647-922-5865 or fill out the form. Tell us roughly how full the garage is and your address. We offer same day garage cleanout across the GTA when you book before noon.

items.title: We Arrive On Time
text: Our crew shows up on schedule. We give you a firm upfront price before touching anything. No surprises, no extra charges.

items.title: Gone — All of It
text: We load everything into the truck, sweep up, and leave your garage empty and clean. One visit. Done.

items.q: How much does a garage cleanout cost?
a: Our service starts from $99. The final price depends on how full the garage is and what types of items need to go. All prices are confirmed upfront before any work begins. No hidden fees.

items.q: Do you take everything or just certain items?
a: We take almost everything — old tools, appliances, furniture, boxes, renovation debris, tires, and scrap metal. If you are unsure about a specific item, just ask when you book.

items.q: How fast can you do the cleanout?
a: We offer same day garage cleanout across most of the GTA when you book before 12pm. Call 647-922-5865 or fill out the form to check availability.
A full garage cleanout includes loading all items into our truck, responsible disposal, and sweeping up before we leave. All labour is included in the upfront price.
